exportInfo.exportedFrom: Cedar Mutual Insurance — ZIA Production Tenant

policy.name: Block-Cloud-Storage-All-Users
policy.description: Blocks personal and business cloud storage services for all corporate users in alignment with the IT Security Standard (POL-IT-009) section 5.4. This rule was created in response to the Q3 2024 audit finding that personal cloud storage was being used to exfiltrate underwriting data. Scope: ALL users, ALL locations, ALL departments. Override path: file an exception via ServiceNow form SR-NET-URL-EXC. Last reviewed by Network Security: 2026-04-02.

CLOUD_STORAGE_AND_BACKUP.description: Sites that provide cloud-based file storage, backup, and synchronization. Includes personal and business-tier services. Zscaler-maintained category; see Zscaler URL Database for the full list.
CLOUD_STORAGE_AND_BACKUP.note: Microsoft OneDrive (onedrive.live.com, *.onedrive.com, *.sharepoint.com) is in this category but is explicitly bypassed by rule id 1004715 (Allow-Microsoft-365-Cloud-Storage).

downstreamEffect.summary: Cloud storage destinations resolve, TCP/443 connects, then Zscaler ZIA returns HTTP 403 with the end-user notification URL. End user sees the Cedar Mutual block page titled 'Access blocked — Cloud Storage policy'.
downstreamEffect.exampleUserExperience: When an employee browses to dropbox.com from any Cedar Mutual-managed device (on-network or via ZIA tunnel), the page is replaced with the Cedar Mutual block page. The Dropbox desktop client cannot sync; it shows 'Connecting...' indefinitely.

relatedRules.name: Allow-Microsoft-365-Cloud-Storage
relatedRules.note: Carves OneDrive and SharePoint Online out of the cloud-storage block. No equivalent carve-out exists for Dropbox Business.

relatedRules.name: Allow-Box-Vendor-Workflow-Limited
relatedRules.note: Carves box.com out of the block, but only for the 'finance-vendor-exchange' user group. Does not apply to general users.

notes: This rule does not distinguish between Dropbox Business (Cedar Mutual tenant) and personal Dropbox. The Zscaler URL category CLOUD_STORAGE_AND_BACKUP groups all Dropbox-owned hostnames together.
Carve-outs require either a custom URL category or a per-rule allow at a higher rank than this block rule. Neither exists for Dropbox Business as of the export date.
Exception requests received in Q1 2026 referencing Dropbox: 14 tickets. All routed to Network Security via SR-NET-URL-EXC; none yet approved.
Compliance owner: Information Security. Operational owner: Network Security.
